messages.text:
BL-1093 — The dispatch-gap sweep auto-routes to `to: none` and swarm_handoff rejects it, while the unassigned-active nudge built for exactly this case cannot see the ticket because the field is PRESENT - so it strands between two sweeps and the daemon retries every ~10s forever
What it solves: Reached from a coder note, "4 misroutes: active tickets keep mint status:todo assigned_to:coder forever". The count and the field both turned out differently once the sweep was run rather than reasoned about: the four `assigned_to: coder` actives (BL-1015, BL-1045, BL-1069, BL-713) all HAVE dispatc…
Approval context: Firm: an active ticket whose `assigned_to` names nobody must reach the coordinator. That path already exists and was built for exactly this case - it simply cannot see these tickets.
Your call on ONE thing: which spellings count as nobody. BL-1047 measured four in the live corpus - the key absent, …
BL-1093 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1093" (or "reject BL-1093 <reason>") to act.
